datasets.title: The Global Flood Impacts Database (GFID): A globally aggregated and geocoded flood disaster impacts database
datasets.description: The Global Flood Impacts Database (GFID) is a globally aggregated and geocoded compilation of flood event and impact records from the Dartmouth Flood Observatory (DFO), DesInventar (hosted by UNDRR), the Emergency Events Database (EM-DAT) and the Historical Analysis of Natural Hazards in Europe (HANZE). It includes 136,642 flood events from 197 countries or territories, of which 82,245 (60.2%) have at least one reported non-zero impact or damage field. The aggregated dataset includes harmonized records of event date, representative coordinates, fatalities and number of people affected, and retains source-specific records of economic losses and other damage indicators. The release also includes original source files, geocoded files, a potential duplicate-screening file, supporting geocoding files and R code.
datasets.purpose: To provide a harmonized compilation of flood event and impact records from four publicly available multinational disaster databases, supporting cross-database exploration and spatial or spatiotemporal analysis of flood events and reported impacts while preserving source-specific identifiers, fields and provenance.

project.name: A Global Synthesis of Flood Impacts: Understanding the Country-level Vulnerability and Causes (USGS John Wesley Powell Center for Analysis and Synthesis)

datasets.details: Published 2026-10-05; no updates planned. Limitations: (1) Coordinates are representative event locations (WGS 84) for spatial indexing; they are not exact flood locations, flood footprints, inundation boundaries or complete impact areas. (2) GFID is not a complete census of global floods: geographic and temporal coverage, event definitions, inclusion thresholds and reporting practices differ by source, and missing values generally mean unavailable, unreported or not applicable. (3) Some records carry anomalous or implausible dates, including early DesInventar records retained for provenance; screen date and year fields before temporal analysis. (4) Source-reported impacts were not independently verified, and source-specific impact fields (definitions, currencies, price adjustments) should not be assumed directly comparable without further harmonization. (5) Potential duplicates across sources are flagged where an event from another source falls within 30 days and 25 km; these are screening indicators, not confirmed duplicates, so summing impacts across sources may double count. Flood area fields are present for DFO (Area) and HANZE (Area flooded) records only.

datasets.rights: USGS marks this data release as CC0 1.0 (public domain) with no access or use constraints. Source-specific fields should be interpreted according to the documentation and terms of use of the original data providers (DFO, DesInventar, EM-DAT, HANZE).

lineage.description: Flood event records were compiled from DFO, EM-DAT, HANZE and DesInventar. Source-specific workflows in R geocoded the DesInventar, EM-DAT and HANZE records (retaining source coordinates or assigning representative coordinates; HANZE uses reported NUTS regions with a country-level fallback) and harmonized selected date, coordinate, source-identification and impact fields. The processed records were combined into an aggregated workbook with one sheet per source and a harmonized sheet. Records were then screened for potential cross-source duplicates using a 30-day and 25-km criterion. Processing date: 2025-10-16. Source coverage: DesInventar 1800-01-01 to 2025-09-24; HANZE 1871-05-29 to 2025-05-19; EM-DAT 1900-01-06 to 2025-10-03; DFO 1985-01-01 to 2021-10-06.

resources.title: AggregatedFloodData.xlsx
resources.description: Main GFID workbook: one harmonized 'Aggregated' sheet (event ID, source, dates, representative coordinates, country, location, fatalities, affected and source-specific impacts) plus one sheet per source (DFO, DesInventar, EM-DAT, HANZE). Download from the 'The Global Flood Impacts Database (GFID)' ScienceBase page.

resources.title: Potential_Duplicate_Events.csv
resources.description: Event-level screening file flagging records with at least one potentially duplicate or overlapping record from another source database (within 30 days and 25 km). Not confirmed duplicates.

resources.title: DesInventar_Geocoded.csv
resources.description: DesInventar flood records with final representative coordinates (GEO_LAT, GEO_LON) and geocoding method (GEO_METHOD). Download from the 'Geocoded Data' ScienceBase page.

resources.title: EMDAT_Geocoded.csv
resources.description: EM-DAT flood records with final representative coordinates (GEO_LAT, GEO_LON) and geocoding method (GEO_METHOD). Download from the 'Geocoded Data' ScienceBase page.

resources.title: HANZE_Geocoded.csv
resources.description: HANZE flood records with representative coordinates (LAT, LON) derived from reported NUTS regions or a country-level fallback, and geocoding method (GEO_METHOD). Download from the 'Geocoded Data' ScienceBase page.

resources.title: DFO_FloodData.csv
resources.description: Original Dartmouth Flood Observatory flood event records, unaltered. Download from the 'Original Data' ScienceBase page.

resources.title: EMDAT_FloodData.xlsx
resources.description: Original EM-DAT flood disaster records, unaltered. Download from the 'Original Data' ScienceBase page.

resources.title: HANZE_Events_v3.csv
resources.description: Original HANZE historical European flood event records, unaltered. Download from the 'Original Data' ScienceBase page.

resources.title: DesInventar_FloodData.csv
resources.description: Original DesInventar country flood reports combined into a single file. Download from the 'Original Data' ScienceBase page.

resources.title: DesInventar country flood reports
resources.description: Individual country flood reports exported from DesInventar as Microsoft Excel files, with an image documenting the retrieval process. Download from the 'Original Data' ScienceBase page.
